s: Dine lisha beyom tob ubo t"v seipim: asur limdod beyom tob, mippene shehu obadin dechol, venireh kemoker. Vaapillu leatzmo (sheeno moker kelum) — asur limdod. Vaapillu mitkavven lemitzva, kegon shemmoded qemach leissato kede leda shiur challa — lo yimdod, ella yiqqach beomed haddaat, shehare haya epshar limdod meereb yom tob.

En tzarik laarot haqqemach mehakkeli letok haareba, ella muttar liqqecho beyadayv mehakkeli ap al pi sheoseh guma baqqemach hannishar bakkeli, sheen issur asiyyat guma shayyak lo beqemach velo beperot, shehare issur asiyyat guma eno ella mishshum boneh, veen binyan ella beqarqa o bimchubbar laqqarqa.

Haharqada hi mimmelakot haasurot beyom tob apillu letzorek akila, kemo shennitbaer besimman ttz"h, lepikak apillu al yede shinnuy asur leraqqed, vaapillu lo haya epshar lo leraqqed meereb yom tob. Umikkol maqom, yesh lehattir leraqqed al yede nokri im yeshanneh qetzat, lepi sheyyesh mi sheomer sheapillu yisrael muttar leraqqed al yede shinnuy qetzat, lekak yesh lismok al debarayv lehaqel al yede nokri. Bammeh debarim amurim? Beharqada rishona, abal im kebar nirqad haqqemach paam achat verotzeh leraqqedo shenit beyom tob kede sheyyehe happat naeh — muttar, lepi sheen issur bimraqqed ella mishshum shehu borer okel mittok happesolet al yede napa o kebara, vekan hakkol yotze mehannapa veen sham pesolet. Umikkol maqom, kevan shehaya epshar lo litroach tircha zo qodem yom tob (veod shehi keen obadin dechol), (lepikak) tzarik leshannot qetzat birqidato, dehaynu shello yeraqqed al gabbe areba kedarko bekol hashshana, ella al gabbe hashshulchan. Veim ap bekol hashshana hu meraqqed al gabbe hashshulchan — tzarik laasot shinnuy acher.

Qemach shennirqad meereb yom tob venapal letoko tzeror o qesam beyom tob — asur littelo mishsham beyadayv, shehare hu borer pesolet mittok haokel, vehabborer pesolet mittok haokel apillu beyado — chayyab mishshum borer, kemo shennitbaer besimman shy"t, umeleket habberira hi mimmelakot haasurot beyom tob apillu letzorek akila, kemo shennitbaer besimman ttz"h. Abal muttar leraqqedo paam hashshenit beyom tob veeno tzarik leshannot kelal, shello hitzriku shinnuy ella bemaqom shehaya epshar laasot meereb yom tob, vezeh sheeno chozer umeraqqed kede sheyyehe happat naeh ella bishbil tzeror veqesam shennapal letoko, vekevan shello napal letoko ella beyom tob, im ken beereb yom tob lo haya tzarik lachazor uleraqqedo.

Hallash issa beyom tob — muttar lehaprish mimmenna challa, apillu en lepanayv kohen sheyyitten lo leekol, o shehu bimqomot shehachalla nisrepet veen tzorek akila kelal behaprasha zo. Veap al pi shehaprashat terumot umaasrot beyom tob yesh bah mishshum shebut, mippene shehu kimtaqqen keli beyom tob, mikkol maqom, kevan shehittiru lalush beyom tob kede sheyyokal pat chamma, vei epshar lo leekol belo haprashat challa — hittiru gam ken lehaprish.

Abal issa shennillosha meereb yom tob — asur lehaprish mimmenna challa beyom tob, shehare haya yakol lehaprishah beereb yom tob. Ella ketzad yaaseh? Im hu bechutz laaretz — lo yopeh kol haissa beyom tob, ella yeshayyer miqtzatah, veachar yom tob yaprish challa min hammeshuyyar, veyiptor kol haissa sheakalah beyom tob, sheheqellu bechallat chutz laaretz lihyot okel veholek veachar kak maprish challa mehammeshuyyar, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea simman shk"g ayyen sham. Abal asur leepot kol haissa beyom tob uleshayyer miqtzat happat kede lehaprish mimmenna challa leachar yom tob, shehare miqtzat zeh eno yakol leoklo beyom tob, venimtza kesheapa oto asa melaka shello letzorek akila. Veap al pi shehittiru lemallot hattannur pat ap al pi sheeno tzarik lekol happat beyom tob mippene shehappat neepeh yapeh kesheyyesh pat harbeh battannur kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tq"z, mikkol maqom lo hittiru lo ella keshekkol happat shello, sheepshar lo leekol kol pat upat ezo sheyyirtzeh, veim yizdammenu lo orechim yakol leekol et kol happat. Abal keshemmiqtzat happat eno birshuto leoklo kesheyyirtzeh, ubeereb yom tob haya epshar lo lehaprish ulechalleq miqtzat zeh mikkol haissa — asur leepoto beyom tob, kemo sheyyitbaer. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim deen issur ella kesheepshar lo lehaprish ulechalleq miqtzat zeh mehaissa beyom tob beshaa sherotzeh leepotah, abal kan sheasur lo lehaprish challa beyom tob, ap al pi shemmuttar leshayyer miqtzat haissa, sheyyesh beoto miqtzat yoter mikkede shiur challa, mikkol maqom, kevan sheoto miqtzat hayyoter al kede shiur challa en issur leepoto beyom tob, shehare hu muttar baakila lezarim, vehachalla atzmah sheenah reuya laakila asur lehaprishah ulechalleqah mehaissa ap al pi sheeno qore lah shem, ap al pi shebbeereb yom tob haya epshar lo lechalleqah mehaissa, mikkol maqom, kevan shebbishat haapiyya i epshar lo lechalleqah mehaissa — muttar leepot hakkol beyachad, lepi sheapiyyat hachalla hi gam ken tzorek yom tob, sheim lo yehe muttar lo leepotah — lo yukal leepot kol haissa, veyitbattel missimchat yom tob. Veap al pi shehaiqqar kisbara haacharona, mikkol maqom lekattechilla yesh lehachamir velachush lisbara harishona.

Veim hu beeretz yisrael, veken bechutz laaretz, im hu rotzeh yukal lalush od issa qetanna beyom tob vitzarep shette haissot bikli echad beinyan shehem mitztorpot lechalla, vekevan sheggam issa haqqetanna nitchayyeba bechalla al yede tzerup zeh — yaprish mimmenna challa gam al haissa shennillosha beereb yom tob. Veim rotzeh lalush od issa gedola sheyyesh bah shiur challa — eno tzarik letzorpan bikli echad, raq sheyyizzaher shebbishat haprashat challa yihyu shette haissot semukot zo etzel zo, kemo shennitbaer besimman tn"z.

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshetztzarik laissa haqqetanna beyom tob, abal im eno tzarik lah beyom tob, veeno opeh otah ella kede lehaprish mimmenna challa al haissa hannillosha meereb yom tob — hare zeh asur, ella im ken okelah kullah beyom tob.

Hammaprish challa meissa temea o meissa tehora venitmet hachalla — hare zeh lo yisrepenna beyom tob, ap al pi sheyyesh mitzvat aseh bisrepatah, lepi sheyyom tob hu aseh velo taaseh, veen aseh docheh lo taaseh vaaseh. Lepikak, bizman hazzeh shekkullanu temeim venitmet hachalla — asur lesorpah beyom tob, vegam asur leepotah, shehare hi asura baakila, vegam letaltelah asur, shehare enah reuya liklum. Abal miyyad kesheqqara lah shem challa vaadayin hi beyado qodem shehinnichah — rashshay letaltelah lekol maqom sheyyirtzeh, kemo shennitbaer besimman rs"v ayyen sham. Umannichah sham ad motzae yom tob, veaz yisrepenna.

Bammeh debarim amurim? Bechallat eretz yisrael shehi asura litmeim, veken bechallat chutz laaretz bimqomot sheen nohagim lehaakila lekohen tahor miqqeri, dehaynu kohen qatan pachot mit' shanim, o kohen gadol shettabal leqiryo, o apillu bemaqom shennohagin lehaakilah ella sheen sham kohen tahor miqqeri, abal im yesh sham kohen tahor miqqeri — muttar leepotah, umuttar lo leholikah lo lebeto, apillu im hiprishah meereb yom tob vehaya epshar leholikah lo qodem yom tob.

Muttar leepot kikkarot abot ugedolot, ap al pi shekkikkarot qetannot yesh bahen torach yoter baarikat kol achat veachat abal kikkarot gedolot en bahen torach kol kak — en anu mechayyebin oto laasot kikkarot qetannot kede lehatricho, veal yede ken lo yabo leepot yoter mikkede tzorek yom tob.

Haya lo qemach o issa beshuttaput im hannokri — asur lo leepot kol haqqemach o kol haissa velachaloq im hannokri achar haapiyya, shehare hu opeh beyom tob bishbil nokri. Veap al pi sheggam chelqo hu mishtabbeach umitalleh al yede chelqo shel nokri, shehappat neepeh yapeh kesheyyesh pat harbeh battannur, mikkol maqom, kevan shechelqo shel nokri eno birshuto shel yisrael leoklo im yirtzeh, veen lo bo ella meat tobat hanaa, veiqqar hanaat haapiyya hi lannokri — hare hanaa muetet zo shel hayyisrael betela etzel hanaat hannokri shehi merubba mimmenna, vahare kol haapiyya hi lahanaat hannokri, vekevan sheepshar lachaloq im hannokri qodem haapiyya — asur lo leepot issato shel nokri beyom tob.

Im yesh leadam pat neqiyya harbeh maspiq lo lekol hayyom — asur lo leepot od pat beyom tob (ella im ken rotzeh leekol pat (chamma) shennillosha hayyom), ella im ken yesh lo bene bayit sheragil lehaakilam pat hadraa. Abal im yesh lo pat hadraa harbeh — muttar lo leepot pat neqiyya letzorek yom tob.
Asur laasot seor leissa beyom tob ella al yede shinnuy, mippene shehaya epshar laasoto meereb yom tob, shekkol kak yapeh happat shennaasa seor shello meetmol kemo happat shennaasa seor bo bayyom.

Muttar lehaprish hammattanot, shehem hazzeroa vehallechayayim vehaqqeba, umuttar leholikam lakkohen, apillu nishchata habbehema beereb yom tob vehaya epshar lehaprishan qodem yom tob, lepi sheen shum issur kelal behaprasha zo apillu beshabbat, shehare eno metaqqen kelum, sheap im lo hiprishan habbehema mutteret baakila. Veod, shemmeporashot veomedot hen, shehare nikkarin hen qodem haprasha kilachar haprasha, ukeshemmaprishan eno oseh kelum.
